data.description:
Discovered by the Step-7 sibling sweep while fixing bug 747f (blobless snapshot materialization).

747f added `_GIT_TIMEOUT = 300` to `src/rebar/_snapshot/**`, joining the existing precedent in `src/rebar/_store/push.py:57` and `src/rebar/_store/sync.py:55`. The sweep found the *timeout* half of that bug class is still live at other network-capable git call sites, each of which can block indefinitely on a stuck remote or a hung credential helper:

- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_ref_lock.py:314` — `ls-remote` (note :347 `fetch` DOES pass `timeout=_REMOTE_TIMEOUT_SECS`, so this is an inconsistency within one module)
- `src/rebar/_engine/rebar_reconciler/_ref_lock.py:760` — `push --force-with-lease`
- `src/rebar/review_bot/gerrit_client.py:304` and :335 — `fetch` against the Gerrit remote
- `src/rebar/opcert_service/workspace.py:70` and :87 — `fetch` review/tickets branches
- `src/rebar/_commands/init.py:375` — `fetch <remote> <branch>`
- `src/rebar/_commands/fsck_repair.py:338` — `push origin HEAD:tickets`

Not fixed under 747f: the operator scoped that change to `src/rebar/_snapshot/**`, and `_engine/rebar_reconciler/**` plus `llm/**` are concurrently owned by other sessions.

Also noted, NOT yet judged a defect: `src/rebar/llm/workflow/snapshot.py:182` materializes via `git archive`, which — like the `read-tree`/`checkout-index` pair 747f fixed — has no batching prefetch, so it would degrade the same way on a promisor clone. Worth confirming whether that path is still reachable (the `repo_snapshot` module docstring describes it as the superseded lossy path) before spending effort on it.

Acceptance criteria: (1) every network-capable git call site listed above either passes an explicit timeout or is documented as deliberately unbounded with a reason; (2) a timeout surfaces as a descriptive error, never a hang, following the `_store/push.py` synthetic-`CompletedProcess(124)` precedent; (3) `make lint`, `make typecheck`, and the default suite exit zero.
data.title: Bound the remaining network-capable git call sites with an explicit timeout
